mapping.preserved: 4.50 mm socket length; default 1.60 mm sheet; four shoulder-supported tongues in matching base sockets; connected removable carrier inspired by actual low-web cross-sections.
mapping.proposedFits: Total socket allowance 0.10–0.30 mm. Socket (sheet+allowance) ×4.50 mm; tongue (4.50-allowance) ×sheet. Glue, not capture. Cradle slot width=beam width+0.30–0.80 mm.
mapping.newStructure: Six original solids: 110×62 mm base, two 42 mm wide cradles with three width-matched shallow notches, three equal-span rectangular beams, widths b/b+2/b+4 mm. Support centre span 64–82 mm. Beam length=span+12 mm.
mapping.runner: 24 accessible bed-aligned runners, width0.8–1.4 mm, height0.4–0.6 mm, increased from measured source0.21–0.22 mm low webs.
mapping.variation: Changes actual support sockets, strip span/width/thickness, notches, ergonomic outlines and carrier geometry; not a source re-export or keycap clone.
mapping.physicalLimits: Undeformed assembly only. Relative ideal stiffness k∝b t³/L³; finite supports and unknown hand forces prevent calibrated comparisons. PETG suggested, tiny hand displacement only, no weights or load rating.
mapping.differences: Not the source cat spacecraft or prior slit, vernier, bridge or optical kits. Six-piece simply-supported removable beam comparison assembly. Reuses independent Daily Object Lab studio/import/export infrastructure; replaced assembly geometry, interface locations, lane dimensions, placement and mechanical tests.
